guide_exact_changed_lines: 7. **Intermediary reporting.** Art. 610 professional/ancillary securities payers obtain identity and real domicile before payment/account opening, report beneficiary identities and net payments, and annex the true-owner list where coupons are presented for third parties. 7. **Intermediary reporting.** Art. 610 professional/ancillary securities payers obtain identity and real domicile before payment/account opening, report beneficiary identities and net payments. Coupons are presumed to belong to the presenter unless proved otherwise. For third-party coupons, the presenter can supply a list giving the presenter’s and true owners’ names and real domiciles and each owner’s coupon amount; the payer must annex that list if supplied. Keep supporting records to the end of the fourth year after payment, unless a longer duty applies. Art. 611 covered habitual securities custodians send prescribed account opening/closure notices within the first ten days of the next month and obtain the receipt; they report prior-year credited coupons before 1 February. These are distinct duties from paying IRCM. [CGI arts. 610–611](https://dgi.bf/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/CGI-2026-v2.pdf#page=260).
